title: Hoshino Ichika — My Feelings, Your Heart〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Excuse me. Um...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, it's Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hi, Ichika! Are you here to see Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um, well...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's up? Did you forget your textbook or something?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's not that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm actually here to see you, Kohane...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh... I knew you and Minori were sort of close, but I didn't know you knew Kohane too, Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know her from doing street performances...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I told you about playing in public to get better at singing, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: At first, I couldn't sing or play anything...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That was when I saw Kohane doing her own street performance and asked her for some help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then you're just like me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In the beginning, I made a lot of mistakes, had equipment issues and felt like nothing was ever going to go well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But my teammates all came together and told me that they believe in me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm sure Shiho feels the same way about you, Hoshino. That has to be why she's willing to teach you so much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That actually happened?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It did. Kohane gave me the courage to keep trying, and I was able to start doing street performances on my own.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know I should've done this sooner, but I'd like to thank you for your help.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Teehee. I'm so glad everything worked out, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And there's something else I need to tell you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We've decided as a band to try and go pro.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: P-Pro...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's so cool!
Ichika and Shiho... Professionals...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're nowhere near that yet...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure it's going to be a tough road ahead, but we're gonna give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! We'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I finally got to thank Kohane for her help. Now I should...)
Kamiyama High School - School Gate

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Hoshino. That took longer than I expected...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. I'm sorry for asking you to meet me on such short notice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But there's something I need to tell you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Tell me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I... My band, Leo/need... We've decided to try and go pro...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really...?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been such a big help to me and taught me so much about singing...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. What happened after all that...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You were right. All I needed was a little more confidence.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I found out just how much fun it is to play music.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we played on stage together as Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When we knew that our music was reaching everyone that was there to listen...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was unbelievable and my heart wouldn't stop pounding!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you found what you were looking for.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I managed to discover what I was missing and overcome what was bothering me...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It sounds like you don't need my help anymore...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, I want to get even better! Also, I really enjoy singing with you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, if it's okay with you, can we keep practicing like we have been...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: S-Sure. It's been fun to sing with you too so...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you so much, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'll see you later, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes.
